Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Acadia expansion & evaluation plan

Hi Oliver / procurement team,

Following up with this week’s MAP checkpoint — snapshot and next steps toward the expansion close. Appended the latest MAP workbook and the evaluation plan PDF for your technical committee. Key notes: 

- Goal: Expand from 3 pilot teams to org-wide rollout (target pilot-to-prod in Q3). Target close: 2026-08-15 (commercial + SOW).
- Primary expansion asks: additional 75k tokens/month baseline, Vector DB integration add-on, 10 extra service seats for CS.
- Evaluation plan: 4-week technical validation -> performance targets (p95 latency < 400ms), security review (SOC2 evidence), and a short P0 prompt-quality eval.

Asks for this week:
1) Please confirm decision committee date windows (we've tentatively put 7/20–7/23).
2) Confirm scope for Vector DB pilot (read-only vs full sync).
3) Procurement — any required SOW templates or required legal points we should preempt.

Attachments: Acadia_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP with milestone owners), evaluation_plan_v2.pdf

Proposed next check-in: Tue 6/30 10:00–10:30 AM ET (15-min standing). If that works I’ll send calendar invite.

Thanks,

--

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acadiahealth.com>

Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Acadia expansion & evaluation plan

Thanks Priyom — quick notes from Acadia side. We’re pleased with the pilot and want to move forward with expansion, with a couple of asks: 

- Add-ons: Vector DB integration is a hard requirement for the first two teams (we need upserts and neighborhood search). Also want a quote for the 10 extra seats for our data science org.
- Security: we’ll need the SOC2 artifact and the answers to our standard security questionnaire (I’ve reattached our template).
- Timeline: Procurement can realistically turn review around in ~3 weeks once the SOW is in a near-final state. If we can get a draft SOW this week, that keeps us on track for the mid-August commercial target.

On decision committee: 7/21 morning is best for the technical stakeholders. I’ll confirm with Eva and legal.
